## Muse Image API

Muse Image is an image generation and image editing model by Muse, available on the Venice API as `muse-image`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Muse Image is Meta's image model, known for faithful instruction following, accurate text and fine detail. It pairs with Muse Image Edit, which changes only what you ask and can compose from several reference images.

### Muse Image API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `muse-image` | Generate | Anonymized | $0.02 / image |
| `muse-image-edit` | Edit | Anonymized | $0.02 / edit |

### Muse Image specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Muse |
| Released | Sep 3, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Aspect ratios | 1:1, 3:2, 16:9, 21:9, 9:16, 2:3, 3:4 |
| Prompt limit | 10,000 characters |

### How to use the Muse Image API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate` with `"model": "muse-image"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "muse-image",
    "prompt": "A retro travel poster with the bold headline \"VENICE\" in large condensed serif type, sunset color palette",
    "aspect_ratio": "1:1"
  }'
```
